title: Tag color mapping in viewer
description: Read __tags slot from GeometryBundle, assign a distinct color from a categorical palette to each tag, and populate per-vertex color arrays. When multiple tags overlap on a vertex, blend or use the most-specific (deepest hierarchy) tag. Integrate with the per-vertex color shader (VIEW-1).
definition-of-done: 1. Tags from GeometryBundle are read and mapped to colors. 2. Each tag gets a distinct, visually separable color. 3. Overlapping tags use the most-specific tag for coloring. 4. Color-coded skull.dsl renders with distinct regions visible.
testing-plan: 1. Tag a cube with two different tags on different faces. 2. Verify each tag region renders in a distinct color. 3. Test with skull.dsl tagged regions.
